settings.line_2: Fastest way to reach the team

settings.heading: Contact Information
settings.text: Questions about a formula, an order, or your routine? Reach the Luma Pause team directly — no bots, no ticket queues. We read and answer every message ourselves.
settings.map_title: Luma Pause sales office location on Google Maps

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: The moment your order ships you will get an email and an SMS with a live tracking link. You can also check status any time under Account → Orders. Metros usually receive their parcel in 2–4 working days; the rest of India in 4–7.

settings.question: Do you ship across India?
settings.answer: Yes — every serviceable PIN code in India, through our courier partners. Orders above ₹699 ship free; below that a flat ₹49 applies at checkout.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: If it has not been packed yet, email support@lumapause.com with your order number and we will amend or cancel it. Once it is handed to the courier we cannot recall it — but you can refuse delivery and we will refund you in full.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Not yet. We are working on it. Join the newsletter and you will be the first to know when we open up shipping outside India.

settings.question: Who are Luma Pause probiotics for?
settings.answer: Our formulas are designed for women in perimenopause, menopause and post-menopause. They are also suitable for any adult woman looking to support gut, intimate or everyday wellbeing.

settings.question: Are your capsules vegan and allergen friendly?
settings.answer: Yes. Our capsules are vegan, gluten-free and contain no added sugar, artificial colours or preservatives. Always check the full ingredient list on the pack if you have specific allergies.

settings.question: Can I take Luma Pause with HRT or other medication?
settings.answer: Probiotics are generally well tolerated alongside HRT and most supplements, but please check with your doctor or pharmacist before starting anything new.

settings.question: How long before I see results?
settings.answer: Some women notice changes in digestion within 1–2 weeks. Deeper benefits — sleep, mood, intimate comfort — build as your microbiome adjusts, so give it 8–12 weeks of daily use before you judge.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened products can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Email support@lumapause.com with your order number and we will arrange a pickup.

settings.question: My product arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: Send a photo of the parcel and the product to support@lumapause.com within 48 hours of delivery. We will ship a replacement straight away — no return needed.

settings.question: How do I choose the right probiotic for me?
settings.answer: Take our 60-second quiz, or tell us your life stage and main concern at support@lumapause.com and we will suggest a routine. It is free, and there is no obligation to buy anything.

settings.question: Where can I buy Luma Pause offline?
settings.answer: Luma Pause is direct-to-consumer for now — here and on select marketplaces. Retail partnerships are in progress; reach out at support@lumapause.com.
